title: Smooth geometric stalks and coordinate-section closed fibres
statement:
Let $v:V\to S$ be a smooth morphism [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] of locally Noetherian schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Choose a geometric point $\bar v$ of $V$ and its image $\bar s$ in $S$ [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $A=\mathcal O_{S,\bar s}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{V,\bar v}$ be the strict local rings, namely the geometric stalks of the etale structure sheaves [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Then $A,B$ are Noetherian local rings and $A\to B$ is a flat local homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. The closed fibre $F=B/\mathfrak m_A B$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. For every ideal $I\subseteq\mathfrak m_A$, the map $A/I\to B/IB$ is flat and local, and has the same closed fibre $F$.

There is also the following coordinate form. Suppose $V=\mathbf A^r_S$ [def-nagata-relative-affine-space], with coordinates $t_1,\ldots,t_r$, and let $K\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ be any subset for which $t_i\in\mathfrak m_B$ for all $i\in K$. Put $k=|K|$. Then for every ideal $I\subseteq\mathfrak m_A$ the ring $B/(IB+(t_i:i\in K))$ is Noetherian and local, its map from $A/I$ is flat, and its closed fibre is $F_K=F/(\bar t_i:i\in K)$. Moreover $F_K$ is regular and
$$\dim F=\dim F_K+k,$$
where dimension is Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

These are the inputs to the agent-supplied strict-local comparison, rather than a claimed single theorem at one tag.
